title: Default Gateway Concept
description: Understand how a default gateway allows communication with remote networks.
scenario: Understand how a default gateway allows communication with remote networks.

concepts.title: Default Gateway
concepts.body: A default gateway is the IP address of a router that forwards traffic to other networks. Without it, a device can only reach its local subnet.
concepts.code:
PC-A: 192.168.1.10/24
Gateway: 192.168.1.1
Without gateway: can only reach 192.168.1.x

concepts.title: How It Works
concepts.body: When a device wants to send to an IP outside its subnet, it sends the frame to the gateway MAC. The gateway routes it.
concepts.code:
PC-A → 10.0.0.5 (different subnet)
PC-A sends to gateway MAC
Gateway routes to 10.0.0.5

concepts.title: Verifying
concepts.body: Use "ping" to test connectivity. "show ip interface" shows the configured gateway.
concepts.code:
SW1# ping 192.168.1.1
!!!!!
Success rate is 100 percent
